name: city-labs

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: node tests/unit/i18n.test.mjs && node tests/unit/spline.test.mjs && npm run test:vspb && npm run test:authoring && npm run test:render
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:mcp && npm run test:roads && npm run test:app && npm run test:update
scripts.test:authoring: node --test tests/unit/authoring.test.mjs tests/unit/commands.test.mjs && node tests/unit/format.robustness.test.mjs && node tests/unit/generators.test.mjs
scripts.test:ui: node tests/browser/materials.test.mjs && node tests/browser/gestures.test.mjs && node tests/browser/workflow.test.mjs && node tests/browser/transparency.test.mjs && node tests/browser/export.test.mjs && node tests/browser/files.test.mjs && node tests/browser/tunnel-shadow.test.mjs
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build:app && npm run test:app && npm run test:update && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked

description: City Labs — редактор города: дороги, рельеф, здания и типы в одном файле .vspb, с MCP для ИИ-агентов
author: vicimpa
